correctness.rationale: The equality reduces algebraically to \(p^a+1=qR_a(p)\). Exact polynomial division gives a finite bound \(p\le C_a+1\) in every layer after excluding positive integer roots of the remainder. The packaged verifier recomputes all bounds, exhausts every admissible prime, and checks the four survivors directly.

value.rationale: The primary paper leaves the equality problem open and specifically highlights a remote exponent-49 two-prime example. Proving that the four displayed triples exhaust every singleton-cofactor two-prime solution through that literature-motivated exponent is a natural finite structural cutoff and establishes that exponent 49 is the first new layer after exponent 6.
